policy: LL3 contrast tables (辨證鑑別) — docs/LEARNING_LOOP_TRACK.md. `compares` (pattern ids) and `dimensions` (axis labels) are structural. The `cells` — WHAT distinguishes each pattern on each axis — are DISCRIMINATORS, i.e. clinical content, and are authored ONLY by the owner, NEVER model-filled (AGENTS.md + LL constraint). Skeletons ship with empty cells + authored_by='model_draft' / status='draft'; the owner fills the cells and promotes status. Every id in `compares` must exist in pattern_library / conditions.tcm_patterns (validate-relations enforces). ids are cmp.<slug>, immutable (DECISIONS D1); retire via review_status='deprecated' (D6).

records.title_zh: PCOS 常見證型鑑別骨架
records.seed_basis: Source-assisted draft approved by Ting: PCOS biomedical context from NIH/NICHD, OASH WomensHealth, and MedlinePlus; TCM pattern discriminator language from Ting's Notion/Bastyr diagnosis and pathology notes. Draft study comparison only; not medical advice.
dimensions: Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索

pattern.phlegm_damp.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: PCOS context with irregular / absent cycles plus damp-phlegm signs: heaviness, weight/metabolic documentation context, chest oppression or nausea, poor appetite, loose stools, leukorrhea; distinguish from pure Kidney deficiency by obvious damp/greasy signs. 多囊月經不規則合併痰濕線索：身重、代謝/體重脈絡、胸悶泛惡、納差便溏、帶下；重點看濕膩與痰濕阻滯。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Tongue / 舌: Pale or swollen tongue, often with white greasy coat; yellow greasy coat if damp-heat signs are also present. 舌淡胖或腫大，苔白膩；若夾濕熱可見黃膩苔。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Pulse / 脈: Slippery or soggy/slippery. 脈滑，或濡滑。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Fatigue/heaviness, abdominal fullness, phlegm/damp sensation, difficult weight loss or insulin-resistance documentation context; may overlap with Spleen Qi deficiency. 疲倦身重、腹脹、痰濕感、體重不易降或胰島素阻抗記錄脈絡；常與脾虛夾痰濕重疊。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Treatment principle / 治法: Strengthen Spleen, transform dampness, resolve phlegm, regulate Chong/Ren and menstruation. 健脾化濕、祛痰，調衝任與月經。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.er_chen_tang, formula.liu_jun_zi_tang; add a course-specific PCOS phlegm-damp formula only after Ting/source review. 學習錨點：二陳湯、六君子湯；PCOS 專門痰濕方待課件/來源確認後再補。

pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: Irregular cycles with stress/emotional constraint, PMS-type breast or hypochondriac distension, distending lower abdominal pain, sighing, mood depression or irritability. 月經不調合併情志鬱結、乳房或脅肋脹、少腹脹痛、善太息、鬱悶或易怒。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Tongue / 舌: Usually normal to dusky with thin white coat; red edges or thin yellow coat if constraint transforms into heat. 舌可正常或偏暗，苔薄白；鬱而化熱可見邊紅或薄黃苔。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Pulse / 脈: Wiry; wiry-rapid if heat, wiry-choppy if blood stasis is also present. 脈弦；化熱則弦數，夾瘀則弦澀。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Pain or distension tends to fluctuate with emotion; may include dysmenorrhea, breast distension, headaches, throat constraint, or digestive upset from Liver-Spleen disharmony. 脹痛多隨情緒波動；可見痛經、乳脹、頭痛、咽中梗阻感，或肝脾不調的消化症狀。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Treatment principle / 治法: Soothe Liver, move qi, regulate menstruation/Chong-Ren; clear heat only when heat signs are present. 疏肝理氣、調經與衝任；有熱象時才加清熱。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.xiao_yao_san, formula.jia_wei_xiao_yao_san, formula.chai_hu_shu_gan_san. 學習錨點：逍遙散、加味逍遙散、柴胡疏肝散。

pattern.kidney_deficiency.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: Long-standing irregular, delayed, scanty, or absent cycles / infertility context with Kidney signs: sore low back/knees, fatigue, dizziness/tinnitus, low libido, or cold/heat deficiency clues. 長期月經後期、量少、閉經或不孕脈絡，合併腰膝酸軟、疲倦、頭暈耳鳴、性功能/生殖力低下，並辨陰虛或陽虛寒熱線索。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Tongue / 舌: Kidney Yang/Qi deficiency: pale, swollen, wet coat. Kidney Yin/Essence deficiency: red or peeled/scant coat. 腎陽/腎氣虛多舌淡胖、苔潤；腎陰/精虧多舌紅少苔或剝苔。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Pulse / 脈: Deep and weak is the broad Kidney deficiency cue; deep-slow-weak for Yang deficiency, thin-rapid for Yin deficiency. 腎虛總以沉弱為主；陽虛偏沉遲無力，陰虛偏細數。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Differentiate Yang deficiency cold signs (cold limbs, clear urine, low libido) from Yin deficiency heat signs (five-center heat, night sweats, malar flush); Essence deficiency leans toward reproductive/developmental insufficiency. 分腎陽虛寒象（畏寒肢冷、小便清長、性功能低下）與腎陰虛熱象（五心煩熱、盜汗、顴紅）；精虧偏生殖/發育不足。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Treatment principle / 治法: Tonify Kidney, support Essence, regulate Chong/Ren; choose warming Yang vs nourishing Yin according to signs. 補腎益精、調衝任；依寒熱虛象分溫腎陽或滋腎陰。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.liu_wei_di_huang_wan, formula.jin_gui_shen_qi_wan, formula.zuo_gui_wan, formula.you_gui_wan. 學習錨點：六味地黃丸、金匱腎氣丸、左歸丸、右歸丸。

pattern.blood_stasis.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: Irregular cycles with fixed, stabbing lower abdominal/pelvic pain, dark-purple menstrual blood or clots, pain worse at night or resistant to pressure; consider when chronic qi stagnation or masses/cysts are documented. 月經不調合併固定刺痛、少腹/骨盆痛、經色紫暗有塊、夜間較重或拒按；常由久鬱入絡、氣滯血瘀或癥塊脈絡提示。
pattern.blood_stasis.Tongue / 舌: Dusky-purple tongue, purple spots, or sublingual venous engorgement. 舌紫暗、瘀點瘀斑，或舌下絡脈怒張。
pattern.blood_stasis.Pulse / 脈: Choppy; wiry-choppy if qi stagnation is also prominent. 脈澀；夾肝鬱氣滯常見弦澀。
pattern.blood_stasis.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Dysmenorrhea, dark clots, fixed pain, masses or endometriosis/fibroid documentation context; distinguish from qi stagnation by fixed stabbing pain rather than moving distension. 痛經、暗紫血塊、固定痛、癥塊或內膜異位/肌瘤等記錄脈絡；與氣滯的走竄脹痛不同，血瘀偏固定刺痛。
pattern.blood_stasis.Treatment principle / 治法: Invigorate blood, transform stasis, regulate Chong/Ren; move qi when qi stagnation is part of the presentation. 活血化瘀、調衝任；若氣滯明顯則兼行氣。
pattern.blood_stasis.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.tao_hong_si_wu_tang, formula.gui_zhi_fu_ling_wan, formula.xue_fu_zhu_yu_tang, formula.wen_jing_tang when cold-stasis signs are present. 學習錨點：桃紅四物湯、桂枝茯苓丸、血府逐瘀湯；寒瘀時參考溫經湯。
